system.description:
As a Bonus Action, swap squares with an adjacent or diagonally adjacent unit. If the targeted unit is not allied to you, you must first pass a Finesse check (DC 4 + target's Agi).

The target must be the same size as the user. If the target is airborne, the user must be able to reach it in melee.
A well-crafted, well-balanced, double-edged sword. The minimum standard of quality for common soldiers and adventurers.
